bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money to the Agricultural Utilization Research Institute.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; AGRICULTURAL UTILIZATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE. +]

[+$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Agricultural Utilization Research Institute for legal costs. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to agriculture; appropriating money to the Agricultural Utilization Research Institute.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; AGRICULTURAL UTILIZATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE.

$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the Agricultural Utilization Research Institute for legal costs. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
